Round 4: FamilySearch gives d. 1 Dec 1707 Jettenbach; she descends to John through daughter Maria Sara Jung (Lampert).

bio: FamilySearch gives Paul Jung's wife Maria Barbara a death date of 1 Dec 1707 at Jettenbach and a birth of about 1637, probably worked back from an age at burial, and cites a Lutheran burial entry ('Maria Junge') and baptism entries ([R4-S1]). FamilySearch's list of the couple's children includes Maria Sara Jung (c.1678-before 1721), the mother of Elisabetha Margaretha Lampert. So even if Gretha Catharina is not a Jung (see H0078), Maria Barbara is still John's ancestor through the Lampert line ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]).
sources: [R4-S2] FamilySearch published tree, Paul Jung (G9S1-G4X), children list (derivative) https://www.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/persons/G9S1-G4X
